a: STRIDE: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Info disclosure, DoS, Elevation.
Attack surface is all entry points an attacker might abuse.
Trust boundaries separate zones with different trust levels.
DFDs map how data moves for threat identification.
Abuse cases describe how features can be misused.
Rate risks by likelihood × impact to prioritize fixes.
Champions embed security thinking inside product teams.
Defaults should be safe; opt-in to riskier modes.
Multiple layers so one failure does not equal total compromise.
Design detection and containment assuming attackers get in.
